title: Lobby redesign port option A (user-approved 2026-09-28): the host sets HostPort 8123 through the Hosting port popup's own Save path -> ONLY the UDP listener rebinds on 8123 (Steam listener + lobby untouched); a client joins by typing '127.0.0.1:8123' in the one address box of Join a Game; the client's own HostPort stays 7777 (the join writes only Port); Change port is refused while the client is in the lobby; with 8125 held by a DEV socket, Save 8125 falls back to 8126, shows the orange busy line and saves the CHOSEN 8125. Restores both rig configs at the end.
preconditions: Dev build with the uiview lobby levers (TestDrive.cs). Both instances at the main menu. UDP 7777, 8123, 8126 free on the rig machine. UDP 8130-8140 free (the item-7 leg holds them).

steps.note: let the main menu finish building (menu injection, theme capture) before the first lever
RESTORE (idempotent): an aborted earlier run can leave HostPort changed

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: saved bound=7777 asked=7777 HostPort=7777

steps.note: PREMISE: the host's hosting port starts at 7777 (first run copies Port)
PREMISE: the client's hosting port starts at 7777

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview host: server=True bound=7777 asked=7777 HostPort=7777$
steps.note: Host New Game through the lobby's own path (OnHost now reads HostPort)

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: saved bound=8123 asked=8123 HostPort=8123 popupOpen=False err=''

expect_log.regex: \[Server\] UDP listener rebound: 7777 -> 8123 \(asked 8123\); Steam listener and lobby untouched\.

steps.note: Change port -> Hosting port popup -> 8123 -> Save: ONLY the UDP listener moves, HostPort saved

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview joinaddr: ip='127\.0\.0\.1' port='8123' err='' started=True
steps.note: Join a Game with '127.0.0.1:8123' typed in the ONE address box: the port is split off and used
the join wrote the JOIN port only; the client's own hosting port is unchanged

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: refused allowed=False hint='Only possible before anyone joins\.' bound=8123 HostPort=8123

expect_log.regex: \[MenuUI\] Change port refused - 2 player\(s\) in the lobby

steps.note: Change port refused while a client is in the lobby
let the host drop the leaver from the lobby
DEV lever: an exclusive UDP socket occupies 8125

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: saved bound=8126 asked=8125 HostPort=8125 popupOpen=False err='' hint='Port 8125 is in use, so friends join on 8126 this time\.'
steps.note: busy port: the +10 fallback lands on 8126, the orange line says so, and the CHOSEN 8125 is what is saved

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview rawpeer: raw peer connecting to 127\.0\.0\.1:8126 \(no hello\)
steps.note: review item 6: a transport connection that never says hello (in neither _clients nor the lobby)

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: refused allowed=False hint='Port 8125 is in use, so friends join on 8126 this time\.' bound=8126 HostPort=8125

expect_log.regex: \[MenuUI\] Change port refused - 1 player\(s\) in the lobby, 1 connection\(s\) open

steps.note: review item 6: the half-joined connection blocks Change port (the hint keeps the busy line: it outranks the 'only alone' line)
review item 7: the whole +10 fallback range of 8130 is held (8125 is released)

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: failed: no free port bound=8126 asked=8130 HostPort=8125 popupOpen=False err='' hint='Port 8130 is in use, so friends join on 8126 this time\.'

expect_log.regex: \[Server\] rebind: no UDP port could be bound \(8130-8140 all in use\) - the UDP listener stays on 8126; nothing changed\.

steps.note: review item 7: nothing binds -> the old listener is untouched, HostPort NOT saved, the approved busy line names the port still in use

steps.expect_result: ^OK uiview port: saved bound=7777 asked=7777 HostPort=7777
steps.note: restore the rig host's hosting port
restore the rig client's join port
